title: Export current-page order and unlinked receipt amount summaries to Excel
description: A sales user downloads the chosen current-page amount summary alongside existing order and unlinked-receipt evidence. For supported customerCurrency SummaryMode, reuse ERP-172 summary DTOs from the same bounded authorized page and add separate order-amount and unlinked-receipt-amount worksheets; none keeps the existing workbook. Recheck current-user sales-order menu and salesperson scope on every export, reject invalid modes before source reads, retain OperationLogMiddleware download audit, and show empty/truncated/unknown evidence visibly. Pending and historical receipts stay separate; never join receipts to orders, infer allocation/receivable balance, merge currencies, or turn null into zero. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused workbook tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel export validates SummaryMode before source reads and reuses the ERP-172 authorized bounded current page; none keeps the existing two evidence worksheets and any selected count-group sheets.

customerCurrency adds separate order and unlinked-receipt amount worksheets with customer, original currency, receipt evidence status, numeric known totals, blank unknown totals with known/unknown counts, visible empty/truncation notes, and formula-safe labels.

Workbook tests cover permission denial, invalid mode, multiple currencies, null amounts, pending/historical receipts, empty/truncated pages, formula-leading labels and unchanged evidence sheets; document the current-page evidence boundary and pass safe Release build/test.
